title: DR1 heads the CPH page with an instruction, "Add the county parish holding number (CPH)"; the frontend heads it with the title-cased field name and nothing else.

finding.frontend: The page heading is the input's own label promoted with isPageHeading, so "County Parish Holding (CPH)" is both the h1 and the field label (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/cph-number/copy/copy.en.js:2-4, src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/cph-number/template.njk:14-18). fe-cph-number shows it title-cased, naming a thing rather than asking for one, and the trader is left to infer that they are meant to type it in. The same term appears title-cased again as the hub row, "County Parish Holding number (CPH)" (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/addresses/copy/copy.en.js:10) — two spellings of one name in two places.
finding.prototype: DR1 heads the page "Add the county parish holding number (CPH)" — an instruction, in sentence case (app/views/cph-number.html:33) — and keeps the short label "CPH number" as the fieldset legend over the input itself (app/views/partials/cph-number-input.html:8-9). Its hub row for the same section reads "County parish holding (CPH) number" (app/data/consignment-address-sections.js:72).
finding.difference: Change the h1 to DR1's instruction and give the input its own label, "CPH number", so the heading stops doing double duty as the accessible label for the field. Bring the hub row's wording to sentence case at the same time, since it is the same name in the same section. If the three-part input lands first, the legend is the natural home for the short label and this becomes a straight heading change.
finding.falsifiedBy: The frontend h1 being needed as the field's accessible label with no other label available, which would make this dependent on splitting the input rather than a copy change on its own.
finding.correction: Stands, and understates the hub-row half. Both pages were read as rendered. The frontend page really is the field label promoted to h1 — the picture shows "County Parish Holding (CPH)" in heading size with the example and the box directly under it and no other label anywhere — and DR1 really does head its page "Add the county parish holding number (CPH)" with "CPH number" as a separate legend over the boxes. The understatement is in calling the hub-row difference a case change. The frontend hub row reads "County Parish Holding number (CPH)" and DR1's reads "County parish holding (CPH) number": the bracket moves as well as the case, so the row is being re-worded, not just re-cased. Both were confirmed in the rendered hubs, not only in the copy files. The dependency on the three-box split is real and is stated the right way round — the h1 cannot simply be reworded while it is still the only label the input has.

relatedTo.why: the h1 is currently the input's accessible label, so where the label goes is settled by whether the input splits
